info.title: Send Any Webhook to Discord API
info.description: Relay any webhook to a Discord channel. Dashboard endpoints use the session cookie set by `/api/auth/login` (or no auth when `AUTH_DISABLED=true`). Webhook ingest (`/h/{key}`) is authenticated by its secret key.
